records.found: The full ZEUS trial report of ziltivekimab was published in the New England Journal of Medicine on 2026-11-07 and presented at the American Heart Association meeting: no fall in heart attack, stroke or cardiovascular death (17.6 against 17.7 per cent, hazard ratio 0.99), despite a 64 per cent fall in the inflammation marker, with more serious infections. This turns the record's company-announcement mark against into a peer-reviewed one, and a careful person would weigh it as a second large null for a drug acting on inflammation alone, which may lower the odds of wide uptake of the class and weakens the case for the colchicine route widening.

findings.what: ZEUS NEJM paper 'Interleukin-6 Inhibition with Ziltivekimab for Atherosclerotic Disease' (doi 10.1056/NEJMoa2612126), 6,376 people; hsCRP down 64%, MACE 17.6% vs 17.7% (HR 0.99, 95% CI 0.88-1.11); serious infections 20.4% vs 17.9%. Crossref record opened; journal page refused (403); numbers read from trade press.
Healio report of the same presentation (AHA, 6-9 Nov), with HERMES and ARTEMIS stated to be ongoing.
Meta-analysis of nine colchicine trials after cardiac surgery (2,005 people): less post-operative atrial fibrillation, no difference in death or stroke.

New colchicine heart trials registered or updated (all not yet recruiting or pilot): NCT07892976, NCT07654231 (kidney disease calcification, started 2026-10-30), NCT07920133 (starts 2026-12-01). None a result.
NCT06263244 (ziltivekimab, anti-inflammatory effects) registry entry updated, completion 2026-10-30; no results posted.
Company announcement of ZEUS already in records (novo-nordisk-2026); the NEJM paper is not.

findings.what: Rat study, Experimental Gerontology: FMT from healthy donor rats improved memory and tissue damage in D-galactose 'accelerated ageing' rats; not naturally old animals, donors not stated as young.
Preprint: capsule FMT in 18 people with mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease, single arm, safety and cognition; no control group.

Registry: ARMOR trial (NCT06649981) FMT in adults aged 65-84, active not recruiting, primary completion 2026-06-17; STEP-aging (NCT05598112) recruiting, primary completion 2026-12-31. Neither updated in the window and neither has results, but they are the nearest human tests.
